title: Design System: Trần Cẩm Linh Portfolio

headline.purpose: Shared sticky H2 paper labels; phone sizes are documented in DESIGN.md.

title.purpose: Okina requested with actual McLaren fallback; original font unavailable.

environment-body.purpose: One rem text with 1.55 line height.

motion.name: gallery-transition
motion.purpose: RAF opacity and carousel interpolation, not a CSS keyframe.

motion.name: gallery-interval
motion.purpose: Timeout advances the selected slide while automatic playback is permitted.

motion.name: marquee-speed
motion.purpose: Measured repeating strip translated in RAF; delta capped at 0.05s.

motion.name: forest-scroll
motion.value: clamped native scroll; travel max(280px, available viewport height * 0.9)
motion.purpose: Foliage opens sideways, sign rises, copy fades; About stops at the blank source background. Reduced motion uses fades.

motion.name: continuous-gallery-speed
motion.purpose: Six image-only galleries; image hover pauses independently, reduced motion becomes native horizontal scrolling.

motion.name: achievement-panel-spring
motion.purpose: Interruptible panel height with matching opacity; reduced motion settles immediately.

motion.name: cloud-breeze
motion.value: 3px horizontal drift, 4px vertical drift, 0.55deg sway plus pointer response
motion.purpose: Original 2026 cutouts drift independently only while visible; focus adds the same lift as pointer interaction.

narrative.overview:
This is a descriptive label for the user's existing Figma system, not a new identity or concept. Original layered trees frame cream paper, hanging signs, purple copy and olive/yellow labels. Open introduces the separate paper wordmarks; Home offers four illustrated destinations; About, Environment, Art and Other preserve the same source world.

Long pages present original projects and achievements as selectable text beside independent source images. Their adaptation changes cropping, columns and spacing to keep the content readable. The visual authority is Figma file `9yn92xRnvfIDmo0eurW1Ow`, its saved source trees and maps under `design/`, and `CONTRACT.md`. No PRODUCT.md or pre-existing DESIGN.md/sidecar was present when this system was documented.
keyCharacteristics: Original layered forest illustrations and hanging source lettering.
Cream reading surfaces, purple copy and olive/yellow paper labels.
Selectable factual copy with independent photographs and certificates.
Native scrolling, visible keyboard focus and controlled automatic galleries.

rules.name: The Source Palette Rule
rules.body: Extend the supplied colors and illustration assets; use scoped readability corrections without substituting a new visual identity.

rules.name: The Selectable Copy Rule
rules.body: Keep source paragraphs, titles, years and captions in semantic DOM text; preserve original wording and punctuation.

dos: Do preserve original Figma copy, independent source assets and node provenance.
Do extend shared page, section and gallery components before duplicating their behavior.
Do keep controls keyboard reachable, visibly focused and at least 44px in their shared action dimensions.
Do measure responsive geometry and cancel animation, observer and listener work on cleanup.
Do distinguish current Chrome evidence from build targets, emulation and unmeasured performance claims.
donts: Don't replace the supplied forest system with a new palette, identity or invented product claims.
Don't flatten body paragraphs, full sections or whole pages into shipping images.
Don't substitute CSS keyframes for the required RAF motion or write React state every animation frame.
Don't invent links, fonts, awards or text corrections absent from the supplied source.
Don't treat passing automation or this system record as a final independent ship verdict; consult the current review and evidence in `artifacts/portfolio/`.
